description: A serene, minimalist contemporary master bathroom photographed in warm, layered light. The entire room is enveloped in warm sandy beige micro-cement or tadelakt plaster on walls and ceiling, creating an uninterrupted tonal cocoon. The floor is warm natural light oak or teak planking laid in horizontal strips. A floating double vanity in warm light oak cabinetry with a lower open shelf occupies the full width of the back wall, topped with a continuous slab in matching light oak tone. Two square white ceramic vessel sinks sit on the vanity surface, each served by a wall-mounted matte black faucet with a small brass accent ring. Between the sinks, a small amber glass apothecary-style bottle, a reed diffuser, and a dark bottle of toiletry are the only accessories, minimal and deliberate. A full-width frameless mirror with a thin black edge spans the vanity width, and a horizontal warm amber LED backlight glows behind it at the top edge, casting a warm uplighting band across the ceiling. The mirror reflects a privacy window with white aluminum or wood horizontal blinds admitting diffused daylight from outside. A strip of small cylinder-style surface-mounted spotlight fixtures is mounted on the stepped ceiling plane at the vanity's upper edge, each emitting a cool-white focused downlight. To the left, a matte black-framed glass shower partition is visible, revealing a rain shower head and matte black shower hardware. The palette is entirely warm — sandy beige, warm oak, matte black with brass accents. The mood is serene and spa-like. Camera is at standing eye-level, approximately 5-6 feet, shooting level with a normal lens in a centered symmetrical composition that shows the full vanity width as the primary focal plane. A lighting fixture matching the product reference image is installed naturally within this scene at the appropriate location for the product category.
